WITH filtered_budgets AS (
  SELECT category, remaining, amount, spent
  FROM budget
  WHERE amount >= 75
),
category_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    category,
    AVG(remaining) as avg_remaining,
    SUM(amount - spent) as total
  FROM filtered_budgets
  GROUP BY category
),
overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(total) as overall_avg
  FROM category_stats
)
SELECT 
  cs.category,
  cs.avg_remaining,
  cs.total,
  cs.total - oa.overall_avg as above_average
FROM category_stats cs
CROSS JOIN overall_average oa
WHERE oa.overall_avg IS NOT NULL
  AND cs.total > oa.overall_avg
